decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Further details are required regarding the levels of the Community Centre and in particular the roof levels and how these relate to existing park and residential properties and of the car parking areas to the east of the site.
description: Following approval for erection of 37 new dwellings (11 x 2 bed houses, 4 x 4 bed houses, 4 X 3 bed houses and 18 x 2 bed flats) and associated parking together with the erection of a new community centre following the demolition of the existing community centre. Alterations and improvements to the public open space, new recreational facilities, increased parking facilities, improved pedestrian routes and improvements to the landscaped areas within the Clayponds Estate- details submitted pursuant to condition 22 (recontouring of the open space) of approved dated 05/07/02.
